summary: Angel Studios, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into amended and restated merger agreements to acquire Tuttle Twins Show, LLC and Toothy Cow Productions, LLC. The amendments extend the outside date to October 31, 2026 and remove a showrunner condition. Consideration involves Angel Studios Class A common stock; company related parties own 41.6% of TTS units and will receive shares. The board recommends the transactions; no advisor named. The deals remain subject to closing conditions. Watch for regulatory approval and shareholder vote timing; risk-arb focuses on insider stake alignment and extended outside date.
